properties.name: reflow2's committed design moves to the item layout, and its accepted checksums onto one baseline change
properties.subject: record
properties.summary: The committed design moves from the single file docs/design/reflow2.json to the item layout docs/design/reflow2/ (one file per node and per edge), and this baseline puts the 579 registered artifacts' current checksums on its CHANGED edges (checksum_after), so from here every accepted checksum lives on the change that accepted it. Nothing about the system moved: the checksums are the ones the record already held. Settled by Anthony 2026-10-03: dec:how-the-saved-design-is-laid-out-so-git-merges-it, dec:the-designs-lineage-is-kept-per-item, dec:item-13-checksums-move-to-change-edges-and-main-converts-in-one-pr (decisions 3 and 6). Reassembled, the layout's whole-design hash equals the single file's (sha256:5f36907f18e67bd39050b9351fc0494a98e0fffa5c0f4f934143fb120ec7bb6d) before this baseline.
